newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wendy's FY99 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wendy's FY99 EPS view cut.

text.p: Everen Securities Dean Haskell said Thursday it reduced earnings estimate for fast-food chain Wendy's International Inc in 1999 by $0.10 to $1.75.
-- His estimates remain $1.35 for 1997 and $1.55 for 1998.
-- He continues to rate the stock market-perform.
-- On Wednesday, Wendy's reported earnings for the second quarter of $0.42 a share, up from $0.38 a year ago, in line with estimates.
-- "While we are pleased with the composition of results for the first time in many quarters, the company has not added significantly to their company-owned unit base," Haskell said in a report.
-- Haskell said it appears the company's expectation for 15 percent increases annual earnings will come solely from the gain in same-store sales and franchised revenues.
